title: Keep two VHS API backends' room/PIN registries convergent through partitions, replays, restarts, clock skew and misconfiguration
derivation: Private vhs-video-stack issue #193 / PR #194 (hybrid hosting slice 1: bidirectional room/PIN registry replication between two API backends under intermittent connectivity) re-synthesized as a sanitized, dependency-free slice of the real api/ tree. db.js, index.js, admin.js and middleware.js are trimmed from the exact base (call-session, telemetry, quality, auth and user routes removed; LiveKit SDK replaced by a local HMAC token); better-sqlite3 and express are replaced by read-only stand-ins over node:sqlite and node:http (api/lib/). The oracle is the merged PR's non-test diff applied verbatim to the trimmed files: new sync.js (logical clock, LWW merge with tombstones and content tiebreak, diff/apply) and sync-routes.js (x-sync-secret guard), db.js migration/backfill, soft-delete, revive-by-name, clock seeding and registry adapters, and the /sync mount in index.js. The PR's Jest/supertest suite is replaced by held-out operational scenarios: separate module graphs and SQLite files per backend, restarts on the same file, partitions, stale and duplicate delivery, crafted skewed/tied peer snapshots, a database created with the pre-PR schema, and misconfigured secrets. The wire format, applied-count meaning and backfill rule, which the issue left open but the checks need, are stated in TASK.md from the oracle. No private hostnames, credentials or data are included.
coverage: Two-to-three-backend replication through HTTP only: export, peer-only create, PIN interchangeability, LWW both directions, same-millisecond ordering, commutative merge with exact ties, tombstone tie rule, timestamp preservation, delete propagation, no resurrection from stale peers, unseen deletes, revive-by-name, idempotent re-delivery, no duplicate rows, clock skew, restart persistence and clock seeding, in-place schema upgrade with backfill, secret guard and malformed payloads; plus preservation of the disabled-by-default deployment and existing room/token/admin contracts.
historical_exposure: Private history; synthetic fixture has low recognition risk.
residual_rubric: Design notes on the timestamp and tombstone choices, and the prose for a future background scheduler, are not graded.
Code structure (purity of the merge layer) is encouraged but not graded.
required_environment: Full upstream task: Node 20+ with npm dependencies (express, better-sqlite3 native build, cors, cookie-parser, livekit-server-sdk, jest, supertest). The packaged slice runs on michael-replay-grader-node:mb008 (Node 24, node:sqlite, loopback HTTP, no npm) with vendored express/better-sqlite3 stand-ins.
